payload.title: The console has no HR workspace: Company hosts the whole HR module, including a pay group (payroll, HR finance, HR analytics) gated only by the global TENANT_ADMIN or MODULE_MANAGER role, and the hr-module remote exposes PayrollPage and the HR dashboard outside its ./Module entry
evidence: web/shared-ui/src/components/Layout/console/railTypes.ts:20 (the workspaces are aqua, gh, ctl and org; there is no hr)
web/shell/src/console/nav/workspaces/org.ts:74-78 (the org-pay group lists payroll, hrFinance and HR analytics in Company)
web/shell/src/console/nav/pages/finance.ts:14 (FINANCE_ROLES, which gates hrFinance, is TENANT_ADMIN, MODULE_MANAGER)
payload.rule_violated: D6 keeps salary and HR finance visible only inside HR, and D2 says a Company role never sees module-private data
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-26, release R6.
